'''Trade monarch''' was the title of the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and its [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]] of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], [[Deko Neimoidia/Legends|Deko Neimoidia]], and [[Koru Neimoidia/Legends|Koru Neimoidia]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] kept in contact with the [[Unidentified Trade Monarch/Legends|Trade Monarch]] via [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] communications within the Federation delegation offices in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Episode I">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>
